regime: Gong et al.: F8 codes concatenated with 8T->CCZ
strength: a concatenated protocol of Gong, Pattison, Rall and Wills (arXiv:2608.09727; literature_imports/ccz72_d6/): an F8 code fed by copies of the 8T->CCZ protocol, rebuilt here from the paper's construction and written as one circuit; a verified witness, not a maximum
label: GPRW-72T-CCZ
origin: A. Gong, C. A. Pattison, P. Rall, and A. Wills, "Magic State Distillation via Codes over Binary Extension Fields," arXiv:2608.09727 (2026)
provenance: (8T -> CCZ) * (9CCZ -> CCZ) of Table 7: the F8 code of Construction 4.5, Eq. (49), binarised in the self-dual normal basis of Eq. (46), each of its nine input CCZ states made by its own 8T -> CCZ, written as one circuit with the nine inner checks as wires 9..17
notes: A_6 = 37632. The paper states 10^{4.58} p^6 (Table 7). Its Eq. (189) with its Table 5 and the 8T -> CCZ error weights (12, 12, 4) p^2 gives exactly 37632, which is 10^4.576. Clifford correction: Z on each output and CZ on each pair, since transversal U_7 over F_8 deposits (-1)^[u != 0] on the logical qudit u
